watchlisted.title: LangGraph checkpoint persistence and cost diagnostics
watchlisted.next_test: Find non-GitHub evidence that production teams would pay for checkpoint persistence diagnostics before building the CLI.

technology_shift.what_changed: Durable LLM agent adoption made checkpoint correctness, replay behavior, and persistence cost visible operational concerns.
technology_shift.when: 2026-08-09 review of public LangGraph issue evidence.
technology_shift.old_constraint: Checkpoint persistence bugs were treated as implementation details inside developer issue trackers.
technology_shift.new_capability: A local audit could inspect saver behavior and report size, replay, and duplicate-run risks before production incidents.
technology_shift.cost_delta: unclear; no direct spend evidence found.
technology_shift.quality_delta: Potentially better workflow reliability, but only issue-level pain is verified.
technology_shift.accessibility_delta: Public LangGraph APIs make local diagnostics technically reachable, but buyer access is unproven.

watchlisted.buyer: Engineering teams operating production LangGraph workflows.
watchlisted.expensive_workflow: Engineers spend time debugging checkpoint bloat, replay drift, duplicate execution, and persistence failures.
watchlisted.existing_spend: Unclear; public issues show engineering pain and workaround behavior, but no direct spend, procurement, hiring, or paid diagnostic evidence.
watchlisted.paid_experiment: Unclear; require at least one team to ask for a paid audit or agree to a concrete paid diagnostic review before implementation.
watchlisted.paid_wedge: Teams may pay to reduce engineering time spent debugging checkpoint bloat, replay drift, duplicate execution, and persistence failures in production LangGraph workflows, but payment evidence is not public yet.
watchlisted.distribution_channel: Potential CLI from GitHub or PyPI and run locally against user-owned LangGraph saver setups, but adoption channel is not money-validated.
watchlisted.do_not_build_until: Find at least two non-GitHub source classes showing budget, workflow, or paid diagnostic demand, or one team asks for a paid checkpoint audit.

watchlisted.title: Tailscale split-tunnel routing exception diagnostics
watchlisted.next_test: Gather non-issue-tracker confirmation from admins that routing diagnostics are worth a standalone paid review or tool.

technology_shift.what_changed: Privacy networking and zero-trust adoption made split-tunnel routing correctness more operationally visible.
technology_shift.when: 2026-08-09 review of public Tailscale issue evidence.
technology_shift.old_constraint: Routing exceptions were debugged through project-specific issue threads and local admin knowledge.
technology_shift.new_capability: A focused diagnostic report or CLI could compare intended split-tunnel behavior against observed routing state.
technology_shift.cost_delta: unclear; no direct paid diagnostic or procurement evidence found.
technology_shift.quality_delta: Potentially fewer rollout mistakes, but public evidence remains issue-centered.
technology_shift.accessibility_delta: Admin reachability is plausible through public communities, but buyer path is unproven.

watchlisted.buyer: Network admins and small teams administering Tailscale routing policy.
watchlisted.expensive_workflow: Admins lose rollout time diagnosing split-tunnel routing exceptions and policy behavior.
watchlisted.existing_spend: Unclear; public issues show repeated routing pain, but not a specific budget owner, paid diagnostic workflow, or external service spend.
watchlisted.paid_experiment: Unclear; require one admin to ask for a paid routing review or multiple admins to validate the diagnostic offer outside GitHub.
watchlisted.paid_wedge: Unclear; public issues show repeated routing pain, but not a specific budget owner or paid diagnostic workflow.
watchlisted.distribution_channel: Likely CLI or report for admins, but the buying and installation path is still unproven.
watchlisted.do_not_build_until: At least 3 admins confirm they would use an external diagnostic before rollout, or 1 team asks for a paid routing review.

watchlisted.title: ArduPilot telemetry integrity and failsafe diagnostics
watchlisted.next_test: Collect fresh non-private operator evidence and confirm that teams want an external telemetry integrity report.

technology_shift.what_changed: Drone autonomy and telemetry-heavy mission operations make log integrity and failsafe explanation increasingly important.
technology_shift.when: 2026-08-09 review of public ArduPilot issue evidence.
technology_shift.old_constraint: Telemetry and failsafe debugging depended on operator-specific logs and project maintainers.
technology_shift.new_capability: A report could classify telemetry gaps and failsafe triggers if representative logs are available.
technology_shift.cost_delta: unclear; no public paid operator diagnostic evidence found.
technology_shift.quality_delta: Potentially safer post-flight review, but evidence is not money-backed.
technology_shift.accessibility_delta: Useful validation likely requires operator logs, creating a private-data barrier.

watchlisted.buyer: UAV operators, integrators, or safety reviewers managing mission telemetry.
watchlisted.expensive_workflow: Operators need to reconstruct telemetry integrity and failsafe causes from representative logs.
watchlisted.existing_spend: Unclear; telemetry integrity pain is visible, but there is no direct public proof that teams pay for external log diagnostics.
watchlisted.paid_experiment: Unclear; require representative public logs or one integrator requesting a paid telemetry integrity review.
watchlisted.paid_wedge: Unclear; telemetry integrity pain is visible, but there is no direct public proof that teams pay for external log diagnostics.
watchlisted.distribution_channel: Likely report or CLI for UAV operators and integrators, but acquisition requires direct operator validation.
watchlisted.do_not_build_until: At least 3 operators share representative logs for analysis, or 1 integrator asks for a paid telemetry integrity review.
